title: Control ack
description: The simulator's answer to one control-cmd, published on plant/{unit_id}/control/ack. Every command is acknowledged, successful or not, and the acknowledgement carries the status snapshot taken after the command was applied so a caller needs no second round trip.

control_error.title: Control error
control_error.description: Why the simulator refused the command.

code.description: Machine-readable reason. out_of_range is a data time outside the replayed rows, speed_out_of_range a speed outside 1 to 3600, not_ready a simulator that has not finished indexing.

message.description: One English sentence for the operator; never a stack trace and never a secret.

cmd_id.description: The cmd_id of the command this answers.

cmd.description: The command that was received, echoed unchanged.

ok.description: True when the command was applied.

error.description: Null when ok is true, the reason for the refusal otherwise.

status.title: Sim snapshot
status.description: The retained status-sim message as it stands after the command, so the caller sees the effect without waiting for the next status publication.

instance_id.description: Identifier of the running fault injection a successful inject started; absent for every other command and for a refused inject.
